description: Defines the Mail entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing email messages in the mail queue with properties like recipients, subject, body, status, and timestamps.

classes.name: Mail
classes.description: Entity class representing an email message in the mail queue, with properties for recipients, subject, body, status, timestamps, and content type.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the mail entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the mail entity.

methods.name: getSentAt
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when email was sent.

methods.name: setSentAt
methods.description: Sets the timestamp when email was sent.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the email (pending, started, sent, failed).

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the email, validating allowed values.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type of the email (text/plain or text/html).

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the content type of the email, validating allowed values.
